rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Adversarial obfuscations systematically compromise AI and static code-review defenses.
rationale.ai-review: Experiments expose transferable hallucination and instability in LLM vulnerability judgments.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Framework centrally targets and empirically bypasses static-analysis admission checks.
rationale.framework: Reusable multi-agent attack pipeline integrates generation, verification, reflection, and search.
rationale.built-system: Implemented system is evaluated across 500 samples, languages, and detectors.
rationale.agentic: Autonomous agents iteratively produce artifact-level obfuscated malicious code.
rationale.steering: Core mechanism shapes generated code through feedback-guided obfuscation prompts.
rationale.metrics: Defines security evasion potential from consistency, hallucination, and transferability signals.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates mitigation-bypassing malicious code across fifteen vulnerability categories.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled attacks characterize vulnerabilities of multiple third-party detectors and agents.
